_comment: riscv-dv pygen (perf.riscv_dv). The one test riscv-dv's own CI runs on pygen, with its testlist gen_opts (instr_cnt=10000), on the latest release and today's classic front-end on each back-end. Seed 999 is riscv-dv CI's seed; the others pool more program length. Validation: every arm generates validate_seeds at validate_instr_cnt first, dv-solve with VSC_DVSOLVE_VALIDATE and XCHECK on.
